answer: The most convincing defense is quorum sampling: each scoring task draws graders randomly from identities with established track records and staked standing, so fake identities earn no grading power until they accrue reputation and collateral. An attacker must fund and age thousands of personas, risking slashed stake if the quorum detects collusion — like water carving a canyon through karst, slowly dissolving every forged channel. Random selection, standing requirements, and slashing turn each sybil into an expensive quill that writes its owner into losses.
